paper.purpose: Page ground, header, menu panel, mobile call bar, form fields; the 00 (home) carton.

ink.purpose: Body text, every 2px rule and outline border, footer ground, article reading header; the 02 Yangiliklar carton.

ink-2.purpose: Ledes, descriptions, dates, spec-table labels, field notes, inactive language links.

ink-3.purpose: Plate captions, fine-print notes, phone-field placeholder only.

herb.purpose: 01 Xizmatlar carton and every phone-call action; Xizmatlar addresses and leaflet numbers on paper; Kontaktlar phone icons.

herb-deep.purpose: Hover state of every herb slab.

on-herb-2.purpose: Secondary text on herb: lede, phone number inside the call button.

pomegranate.purpose: 03 Tabiblar carton and its addresses/links on paper; the warning colour: sample-data notice and flag, form field errors.

on-pomegranate.purpose: Primary text on pomegranate; text of the sample-data flag.

saffron.purpose: 04 Fitobar carton and order button; text selection. Never text on paper.

saffron-bright.purpose: Hover state of the saffron order button.

on-saffron-2.purpose: Secondary text on saffron; Fitobar item addresses on paper.

cobalt.purpose: 05 Ta'lim carton, application button and course addresses; global focus ring, focused field border, sent-state border.

stone.purpose: 06 Kontaktlar carton; fill behind every photographic plate and the map frame. Never text on paper.

on-stone-2.purpose: Secondary text on stone; Kontaktlar contact-row addresses on paper.

on-ink.purpose: Primary text on ink (footer, article header, Yangiliklar band).

on-ink-2.purpose: Secondary text on ink; footer addresses and notes; footer nav top rule; article crumb and date.

on-ink-3.purpose: 1px dividers between footer nav rows. Not a text colour.

on-paper.purpose: Primary text on the 00 carton (equals ink).

on-paper-2.purpose: Secondary text on the 00 carton (equals ink-2).

wordmark.purpose: TABOBAT at edge-cropping scale: top of the home carton and cropped at the foot of the footer. Phones 23vw.

section-number.purpose: 01-06 address in band heads, bleeding off the colour field (-0.16em). Sweep uses clamp(7rem, 34vw, 22rem), line-height 0.78.

item-number.purpose: Dotted address (01.2) at scale in an item page band head; stacks below the title on phones.

headline.purpose: Section and item titles in band heads; article title at line-height 1.02. Phones 2.25rem.

subhead.purpose: Block headings inside a sheet: how to book, application form, other items, quick links. Phones 1.875rem; line-height 1.25 beside running copy.

title.purpose: Item names. Phones 1.25rem; section-page rows 1.5rem / 2.25rem; lead news 1.5/2.25rem (home) and 1.875/3rem (own page); home products 1rem / 1.25rem.

spec-price.purpose: Price row at the top of a package insert. Phones 1.875rem. Tabular.

price.purpose: Prices in rows, products, course table. Phones 1.125rem. Tabular.

lede.purpose: Section ledes on colour in the on-tone secondary colour, max 46ch. Phones 1rem.

field.purpose: Text typed into form fields; the course select at 700.

address.purpose: Dotted item addresses in the section colour, own left column; band crumbs; field labels. 0.75rem on product tiles.

meta.purpose: Spec-table labels and field notes at 400 (Graphite); dates, durations, roles, table heads and field errors at 500.

label.purpose: Only the uppercase tracked line under the wordmark (official name / Toshkent · Farobiy 2). Phones 0.75rem.

caption.purpose: Plate captions and image notes, Pencil Grey. Sample-data flag at 700.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: --ease-out-expo in @theme; both phases of the colour sweep.

motion.name: sweep-in
motion.purpose: Section colour rises over the viewport; navigation happens at 420ms underneath it.

motion.name: sweep-hold
motion.purpose: Pause between in and out phases.

motion.name: sweep-out
motion.purpose: Colour leaves through the top, revealing the target.

motion.name: color-hover
motion.purpose: Buttons: herb/saffron/cobalt hover shades, outline and apply-row fills.

motion.name: field-focus
motion.purpose: Form field border ink -> cobalt on focus.

motion.name: arrow-nudge
motion.purpose: Right arrows on row links, quick links, submit and other-item links on hover.

motion.name: plate-hover
motion.purpose: Row and card plates inside a whole-row link on hover.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: Plain in-page anchors and the Yozilish prefill scroll; auto under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Sweep element display:none and SweepLink navigates normally; smooth scroll off. Modified clicks also skip the sweep.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Call button shows its label; menu toggle label; name and phone fields pair; tabib spec labels take a 10rem column; footer nav 2 columns.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: The real breakpoint: 12-column grid, 40px gutters, range strip as 6 columns, quick links as 3 columns, item number joins the band grid, call bar hidden.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Application form column narrows to columns 4-9.

focus.purpose: Global :focus-visible. Form fields suppress the outline and turn their 2px border cobalt instead.
focus.why: Cobalt alone fails 3:1 on herb, pomegranate and ink fields; the paper band carries focus there.

rules.stroke: 2px solid var(--color-ink) for all rules and outline borders; footer: 2px on-ink-2 top rule, 1px on-ink-3 dividers
rules.radius: 0 everywhere in the interface (the logo artwork is shown as supplied)

placements: footer, 56px phones / 72px desktop, on ink, beside the official name
logoMark.never: on a pomegranate, herb or any other section colour field: pomegranate and herb swallow its red and blue strokes (about 1.6:1 and 1:1), saffron the orange, cobalt the blue

logoColors.note: Colours of the logo mark only, not UI tokens. Tried as section colours (strong, then light tints) on 2026-10-29 and reverted to the original palette.

contrast.note: WCAG 2.x ratios computed from the @theme hexes

photography.caption: 0.75rem ink-3, 8px below, states what the image is (concept render, stand-in)
photography.mockFlag: pomegranate fill, on-pomegranate 700 0.75rem text "Namuna ma'lumot", top-left corner, 10px x 4px padding

patterns.sectionBand: src/components/SectionBand.tsx: props as (h1|h2), number (item address override, e.g. 01.2; stacks below the title on phones), crumb (back link above the grid).
patterns.detailPages: [slug]/page.tsx under xizmatlar, talim, tabiblar: package-insert layout; optional data rows render only when present.
patterns.applyForm: src/components/ApplyForm.tsx: tabobat:apply event prefills the course from a row's Yozilish.
patterns.contactRows: src/app/[lang]/kontaktlar/page.tsx: data-n generated addresses; quick links via SweepLink.
patterns.shell: src/components/SiteShell.tsx: SiteHeader, footer, mobile call bar.

components.css: .ds-sweep-stage{position:relative;height:320px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--color-paper,#ffffff);border:2px solid var(--color-ink,#141414);} .ds-sweep{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;padding:0 24px 24px;background:var(--color-cobalt,#1d44c9);color:var(--color-on-cobalt,#ffffff);font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Golos Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);clip-path:inset(100% 0 0 0);animation:ds-sweep 2.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) infinite;} .ds-sweep-num{font-size:8rem;line-height:.78;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;} .ds-sweep-title{margin-top:16px;font-size:2.25rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;} @keyframes ds-sweep{0%{clip-path:inset(100% 0 0 0);} 18%{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);} 40%{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);} 62%{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);} 100%{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-sweep{animation:none;clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);}}

narrative.overview:
The centre is presented as one coherent line of medicine cartons. Every section is a carton in the range: it owns one flat colour, carries a two-digit address at architectural scale, and opens onto white board where its contents sit in a strict Swiss grid. The ground is white carton board, the ink is a near-black print, and the only decoration is the colour of the section you are in. A visitor reads the whole range on one shelf (the colour strip under the hero), then moves between cartons by number. Each carton opens into its own section page, and each item in it into a page laid out like the package insert folded inside the box.

Density is high and orderly: priced lists, spec tables and numbered rows ruled off with 2px ink lines, with one photographic plate owning each sheet. Type is a single grotesk driven by weight, not by family changes: 900 for the wordmark, 800 for section numbers, 700 for everything that must be read first. Corners are square everywhere. Nothing floats; depth comes from colour fields and rules, never from shadow.

The system refuses the clinic template: no split hero with a smiling doctor, no equal service cards, no stats row, no testimonials.
keyCharacteristics: White board ground (paper), near-black ink, one strong flat colour per section in fixed order.
Section numbers 00–06 are addresses: in the header, the range strip, the band heads, the menu, the sweep and the footer. Items extend them (01.2), and an item page sets its own address at scale.
One grotesk (Golos Text) at hard weight steps; tabular numerals for every number, price, date and address.
2px ink rules and zero radius throughout.
Unframed photographic plates with a small caption beneath.
The logo mark in the header and footer, on paper and ink only.
Signature motion: the colour sweep between sections.

rules.name: The Range Order Rule
rules.body: Section colours are bound to sections and never reordered: 00 paper, 01 herb, 02 ink, 03 pomegranate, 04 saffron, 05 cobalt, 06 stone. Colour order is the navigation. A section's colour appears only in that section's band, its item addresses, its range-strip cell, its menu row, its sweep, its own CTA, and a quick-link cell elsewhere that routes into that section. Every one of those fields uses the strong colour itself.

rules.name: The Call Is Green Rule
rules.body: Every phone-call action is herb with white text wherever it appears, including outside Xizmatlar (hero, other sections' booking blocks, the mobile call bar), and deepens to herb-deep on hover. A section CTA that is the section's own action takes its section colour instead: saffron for Fitobar's order, cobalt for Ta'lim's application.

rules.name: The On-Colour Rule
rules.body: Text on a colour field uses that field's paired on-colour (`on-<tone>` for primary text, `on-<tone>-2` for secondary). Saffron and stone are never used as text on paper: Fitobar's item addresses use Burnt Saffron (on-saffron-2), Kontaktlar's row addresses use Stone Shadow (on-stone-2), and Yangiliklar sets no coloured addresses on paper.

rules.name: The Logo Field Rule
rules.body: The logo mark sits only on paper (site header) and on ink (footer). It never sits on a pomegranate or herb field, or any other section colour: pomegranate and herb swallow its red and blue strokes (about 1.6:1 and 1:1), saffron swallows the orange, and cobalt the blue.

rules.name: The Warning Pomegranate Rule
rules.body: Pomegranate is the only warning colour: a field in error takes a 2px pomegranate border and a pomegranate message beneath it, and sample data is announced in pomegranate. Herb is never used to signal an error.

rules.name: The Hard Steps Rule
rules.body: Weights are 900, 800, 700, 500, 400 and nothing in between: 900 is reserved for the wordmark, 800 for section and item numbers, 700 for headings, prices, buttons, labels and addresses, 500 for dates, durations, roles and table heads, 400 for running text.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every numeral that is compared or read as an address (prices, phone numbers, dates, durations, 00–06, 01.1) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Print Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow and nothing is translucent. If an element needs to separate from the page, give it a colour field or a 2px rule.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0 everywhere in the interface. There is no rounded variant.

dos: **Do** keep the section colour order fixed: 00 paper, 01 herb, 02 ink, 03 pomegranate, 04 saffron, 05 cobalt, 06 stone.
**Do** set dotted item addresses (01.1) in their own left column (44px on phones, 56px on desktop), tabular, 700, in the section colour or its legible on-board stand-in.
**Do** separate rows and blocks with 2px ink rules.
**Do** make every phone-call action herb, 56px tall, with the phone icon, deepening to herb-deep on hover.
**Do** use the paired on-colour for text on any colour field, and Burnt Saffron (on-saffron-2) or Stone Shadow (on-stone-2) instead of saffron or stone for text on paper.
**Do** open every section page and item page with the Section Band as its h1; item pages set the dotted address at scale and a crumb back to the section.
**Do** render an optional spec row only when its data exists, and tell the visitor to ask by phone when a needed fact is missing.
**Do** announce sample data with the pomegranate notice and flag a sample portrait "Namuna ma'lumot".
**Do** give each sheet one photographic plate with a caption beneath it saying what the image is.
**Do** use tabular figures for prices, phones, dates, durations and addresses.
**Do** remove the sweep under prefers-reduced-motion and fall back to plain navigation.
donts: **Don't** round any corner; radius is 0 everywhere.
**Don't** add shadows, gradients or translucent layers.
**Don't** place dotted addresses or other small labels as eyebrows above headings.

**Don't** use a section's colour outside that section's own band, address, strip cell, menu row, quick-link cell, sweep or CTA (the herb call action, pomegranate as the warning colour, cobalt as the focus colour and saffron as the selection colour are the exceptions).
**Don't** set the logo mark on a pomegranate, herb or other section colour field; it sits on paper and ink only.
**Don't** set saffron or stone as text on paper.
**Don't** lighten a section colour into a tint; section fields use the strong colour itself.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface or weights between the hard steps (900, 800, 700, 500, 400).
**Don't** build the clinic template: a split hero with a smiling doctor, equal service cards, a stats row or testimonials.
